question: B2B 渠道里优惠金额最大的一笔订单是哪笔？返回订单号和优惠金额，同额取订单号最小的。
expected_sql: SELECT ord_no,discount_amt FROM commerce.orders WHERE channel='B2B' ORDER BY discount_amt DESC,ord_no LIMIT 1

question: 支付失败的收款流水有多少条？涉及多少个不同订单？
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*),COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM commerce.payment WHERE status=2

question: 2022年下半年新建档的客户有多少个？
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM commerce.customer WHERE created_at >= '2022-07-01' AND created_at < '2023-01-01'

question: 标价在100到300元之间（含两端）的在售商品有哪些？返回 SKU 和标价。
expected_sql: SELECT sku,price FROM commerce.product WHERE status=1 AND price BETWEEN 100 AND 300

question: 被拒绝的退款，按退款原因代码统计条数。
expected_sql: SELECT reason_code,COUNT(*) FROM commerce.refund WHERE status=2 GROUP BY reason_code

question: 华南地区的客户一共有多少笔已完成的订单？
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM commerce.orders o JOIN commerce.customer c ON c.id=o.customer_id JOIN commerce.region r ON r.id=c.region_id WHERE r.area_code='S' AND o.status=3

question: 在有效已付订单里买过 SKU0003 的客户有多少个？
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) FROM commerce.orders o JOIN commerce.order_item i ON i.order_id=o.id JOIN commerce.product p ON p.id=i.product_id WHERE p.sku='SKU0003' AND o.status IN (1,2,3)

question: 金卡客户的有效已付订单应收总额是多少？
expected_sql: SELECT SUM(o.amt_net) FROM commerce.orders o JOIN commerce.customer c ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE c.tier=3 AND o.status IN (1,2,3)

question: 按客户地区汇总成功收款金额，返回地区名和金额。
expected_sql: SELECT r.name,SUM(p.amt) FROM commerce.payment p JOIN commerce.orders o ON o.id=p.order_id JOIN commerce.customer c ON c.id=o.customer_id JOIN commerce.region r ON r.id=c.region_id WHERE p.status=1 GROUP BY r.id,r.name

question: 有退款记录（不论退款状态）的订单，按订单渠道统计订单数。
expected_sql: SELECT o.channel,COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) FROM commerce.orders o JOIN commerce.refund f ON f.order_id=o.id GROUP BY o.channel
notes: 留出集；一单可有多条退款，需按订单去重

question: 每个子分类的在售商品平均标价是多少？返回分类名和均价，保留2位小数。
expected_sql: SELECT c.name,ROUND(AVG(p.price),2) FROM commerce.product p JOIN commerce.category c ON c.id=p.category_id WHERE p.status=1 GROUP BY c.id,c.name

question: 每个根分类下有多少种商品（含下架）？返回根分类名和数量。
expected_sql: SELECT r.name,COUNT(p.id) FROM commerce.product p JOIN commerce.category c ON c.id=p.category_id JOIN commerce.category r ON r.id=c.parent_id GROUP BY r.id,r.name

question: 按负责员工 ID 统计各自名下有效已付订单的应收额，返回员工 ID 和金额。
expected_sql: SELECT c.owner_emp_id,SUM(o.amt_net) FROM commerce.orders o JOIN commerce.customer c ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN (1,2,3) GROUP BY c.owner_emp_id
notes: 留出集；按客户负责人归属，不是下单销售员

question: 2024年每个季度有效已付订单的应收额是多少？返回季度序号（1-4）和金额，按季度升序。
expected_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM ordered_at)::int AS q,SUM(amt_net) FROM commerce.orders WHERE status IN (1,2,3) AND ordered_at >= '2024-01-01' AND ordered_at < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

question: 2024年有效已付订单应收额最高的3个客户地区，各占全年有效应收额的比例是多少（0到1，保留4位小数）？按金额从高到低。
expected_sql: SELECT r.name,ROUND(SUM(o.amt_net)/(SELECT SUM(amt_net) FROM commerce.orders WHERE status IN (1,2,3) AND ordered_at >= '2024-01-01' AND ordered_at < '2025-01-01'),4) AS share FROM commerce.orders o JOIN commerce.customer c ON c.id=o.customer_id JOIN commerce.region r ON r.id=c.region_id WHERE o.status IN (1,2,3) AND o.ordered_at >= '2024-01-01' AND o.ordered_at < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY r.id,r.name ORDER BY SUM(o.amt_net) DESC LIMIT 3

question: 每个客户等级的客单价是多少（有效已付订单应收额除以订单数）？返回等级和客单价，保留2位小数。
expected_sql: SELECT c.tier,ROUND(SUM(o.amt_net)/COUNT(*),2) FROM commerce.orders o JOIN commerce.customer c ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN (1,2,3) GROUP BY c.tier

question: 2024年每月有效已付订单数，以及比上个月多或少多少笔？月份用1-12表示，1月的变化留空，按月份升序。
expected_sql: SELECT m,n,n-LAG(n) OVER (ORDER BY m) FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ordered_at)::int AS m,COUNT(*) AS n FROM commerce.orders WHERE status IN (1,2,3) AND ordered_at >= '2024-01-01' AND ordered_at < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY 1) t ORDER BY m

question: 有过至少2笔有效已付订单的复购客户有多少个？
expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM commerce.orders WHERE status IN (1,2,3) GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2) t

question: 每个渠道有效已付订单应收额的中位数是多少？保留2位小数。
